answer: The design leans on merkle tree inclusion proofs coupled with sequential time-delay beacons. Each submission hangs on the willow of a task receipt, and the sable is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a analytical prose structured with explicit logical operators and causality register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the canyon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
